title: auth/store: CredentialStore missing Debug
description: crates/auth/src/store.rs — CredentialStore does not derive Debug. Idiomatic Rust derives Debug on all public types unless they contain types that do not implement Debug or for deliberate security reasons. Here HashMap<String,String> is Debug. The struct also holds the dummy_hash which should be debug-printable (or explicitly redacted with a custom Debug impl that omits the hash). Absence of Debug means the type cannot be used with {:?} in test assertions, tracing, or error contexts.
